description: This Java class implements a deduplication processing strategy for telemetry data, managing cache expiration and interval calculations to prevent duplicate processing within specified time frames.

classes.name: DeduplicateProcessingStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a deduplication strategy for telemetry processing, with configurable interval and cache management.

methods.name: DeduplicateProcessingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the deduplication interval and cache with validation and configuration.

methods.name: calculateExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Calculates cache expiration duration based on deduplication interval, ensuring retention between 10 minutes and 48 hours.

methods.name: calculateMaxNumberOfDeduplicationIntervals
methods.description: Determines maximum cache size based on total retention duration, capped at 100 intervals.

methods.name: getDeduplicationIntervalSecs
methods.description: Returns the deduplication interval in seconds.

methods.name: shouldProcess
methods.description: Decides whether to process data based on timestamp and originator UUID, using cache to prevent duplicates.
